scope: Synthetic host pixel draw characterizing physical wave width, quad helper neighbors and wave-coalesced append with overflow; does not execute Xbox shaders or establish wave64 ordering equivalence.

amd.scope: Host pixel-wave characterization using a synthetic triangle, not original Xbox shader execution. Overflow is checked for valid unique slots, not equality with the Xbox wave64 subset.

nvidia.scope: Host pixel-wave characterization using a synthetic triangle, not original Xbox shader execution. Overflow is checked for valid unique slots, not equality with the Xbox wave64 subset.

limits: Draw uses a synthetic triangle; pixel grouping and helper participation can vary across draw geometry, pipeline state, hardware and driver.
This validates unique reserved slots and guards, not the exact ordering or selected subset from an Xbox wave64 shader.
No production pixel translation is enabled by this control.
